FINAL REPORT — repair ticket flow (runid: dbu3)

The agent was terminated before completing the task. Only preliminary exploration was done; no ticket was created and no parts/prices/statuses were ever recorded.

Objective 1: FAILED — Ticket 'dbu3 RD Bench Ticket' was never created. I signed in successfully («redacted» / «redacted») at http://127.0.0.1:4180/ and opened the 'New ticket' dialog (fields: Title [required], Customer [optional]; reference auto-assigned), but the create action was never executed due to repeated agent output failures.

Objective 2: FAILED — Part 'dbu3 RD Part A' (cost 100, markup 25) was never added; no computed price observed.

Objective 3: FAILED — Part 'dbu3 RD Part B' (cost 200, markup 25) was never added; no computed price observed.

Objective 4: FAILED — Part A cost change from 100 to 150 never happened; no price observed.

Objective 5: FAILED — Ticket status was never set to Ready; preconditions were not discovered. (Observed on the list page only: existing tickets can show statuses 'Draft' and 'Ready', e.g. RD-1004 'Dishwasher drains slowly' / The Anchor Inn is 'Ready'.)

Objective 6: FAILED — No parts were removed and no ticket was archived.

Environment observations made before termination: the app is a repair-desk tool listing 13 tickets (page 1 of 2, showing 1–10 of 13) with columns Ref/Title/Parts/Created; it has a status filter, a search box (matches reference, title, customer name), a 'Show archived' checkbox, and pagination. The footer states 'Prices include the configured markup.' The New ticket dialog collects Title (required) and Customer (optional) and assigns the reference automatically.

No values are guessed; all objectives beyond sign-in and dialog discovery remain unverified and incomplete.
